action_choice.availability: only exact pre-event ACTIVE actions; NO_BET remains selectable zero flow only when it is the explicit fallback; UNAVAILABLE excluded
action_choice.rule: highest predicted utility strictly > strongest matched prior-only comparator; otherwise exact stage fallback

family_implementation.BINNED_REGIME_RULE: per action, evaluate every numeric projection singly; train-only linear-interpolated quantile boundaries for requested bins; leaf prediction aggregate net/stake; require min_leaf; choose feature by training MSE then feature_ordinal
family_implementation.MONOTONE_REGULARIZED_SCORE: per-action ridge least squares with intercept unpenalized and L2 grid value; projected POOL_VALUE coefficients constrained >=0, UNCERTAINTY_DIVERGENCE constrained <=0, other coefficients unconstrained; active-set coordinate order feature_ordinal; convergence tol 1e-12, max 10000
family_implementation.NEAREST_HISTORICAL_REGIME: per-action Euclidean distance on transformed model columns; distance tie issue chronological ordinal; k from grid; UNIFORM or 1/max(distance,1e-12) weights; prediction weighted aggregate utility
family_implementation.PRIOR_ONLY_FIXED: per-action constant = aggregate training net/stake with minimum support 20; blank/unsupported action excluded
family_implementation.SHALLOW_TREE: per-action deterministic CART regression; squared error; best split over all numeric/encoded columns; thresholds are adjacent-value midpoints; split tie feature_ordinal then threshold; leaf aggregate net/stake; max_depth/min_leaf from grid

feature_projection.column_order: feature_ordinal ascending; each numeric feature followed immediately by its missing indicator; categorical levels lexical with __UNKNOWN__ last
feature_projection.fit_partition: inner-train during selection; full outer-train only after selected family; never validation/test/full sample

outcome_boundary: Gate A outcome-unexposed: target result, final/winning SP, payout, tax realization, ROI, settlement, and any post-cutoff evidence are forbidden from X_i, every stage output, fitting inputs, screens, and tie-breaks

STAGE_3_BET.mandatory: ENUMERATE_UPSTREAM_SUPPORT fallback and accepted FULL when definitionally supported

stage_screen.score: aggregate training pre-tax net / aggregate training stake; minimum active support 20
stage_screen.streaming: complete pass, exact fixed-size heap using the full order tuple; chunk invariant for 1/17/256/4096; no sampling/adaptive early stop

targets.STAGE_1_SELECTION: utility of selector with ALLOW_ALL and FULL downstream controls
targets.STAGE_2_DIRECTION: incremental utility vs ALLOW_ALL on identical honest Stage-1 path with enumerate-support downstream control
targets.STAGE_3_BET: incremental utility vs enumerate-support on identical honest Stage-1/2 path after nuisance-seed averaging

topology.model_scope: one action-specific utility model per retained stage action for every non-prior model family; no joint-action model and no shared multiaction estimator
topology.outer_test: all three families/transforms/screens/models frozen before first issue of held-out year; no within-year outcome update
topology.upstream_training: Stage-2/3 use honest expanding out-of-fold frozen upstream outputs; full upstream rows/digests are audit-bound and only projection fields marked model_input enter estimators

validation.primary: complete-chain sum selected pre-tax net / sum selected stake; blank when stake zero
